title: 《亲友书》科判
author: 子茗（圓雲）
definition: {"nodes":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"1c216d1441914a10d","images":[{"id":"a916d144db6d817b-1005400","oh":688,"ow":1501,"uri":"document_image/5b97750c-83b7-4605-abf4-716cdfa63fa1-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"1616d11606f5204e","images":[],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"【为令堪德善妙者，希福我依佛尊说，稍许集成圣梵音，汝当恭敬而谛听】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"19316d11600c0e02","modified":1612428542256,"note":"","text":"以立誓句劝勉闻者"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"23116d1445dec2149","images":[{"id":"31816d144ed672157-1005400","oh":759,"ow":1508,"uri":"document_image/6201c50a-851e-477f-9fc5-746b67de39bd-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"4816d1163abe902a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"\b【佛像纵然以木雕，无论如何智者供，如是我诗虽拙劣，依妙法说勿轻蔑。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"616d11636b43115","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以词句而谦虚"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"12a16d1448930f13a","images":[{"id":"21016d14516234047-1005400","oh":975,"ow":1811,"uri":"document_image/8bde6ca6-1ab1-4e0e-98a8-dcd03945cd76-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"21716d1165bd9208b","images":[],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"【于大能仁之众教，王汝虽先已精通，犹如石灰依月光，岂非较前更美妙？】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"38d16d11637906157","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以意义而谦虚"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","finish":false,"heading":2,"id":"11316d11602fd1122","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以谦虚方式教诫理当听受"}],"color":"#3da8f5","heading":1,"id":"e16d115f75bc145","modified":1612428542256,"text":"初善首义"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"2316d1449030b178","images":[{"id":"5316d144934b303a-1005400","oh":1348,"ow":1737,"uri":"document_image/dac30b9f-9a78-4d27-8302-98a33907a793-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"16516d11673d6f0e9","images":[],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如来殷切而告言：佛陀妙法与僧众，施戒天尊六随念，各功德资常忆念。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"30816d1166ee83022","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说随念所信之对境——佛陀等六者"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"5b16d14495c37168","images":[{"id":"19a16d144a1aaf17d-1005400","oh":1068,"ow":1875,"uri":"document_image/1d25f35e-6420-4a23-a516-61834bee5137-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"19316d1167d929096","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【身语意门当常依，奉行十种善业道，杜绝一切醇美酒，欢喜贤妙之维生。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"3c316d11677d79034","modified":1612428542256,"text":"随念天尊"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"14416d144977d10be","images":[{"id":"37416d1458ce490a1-1005400","oh":411,"ow":1374,"uri":"document_image/6ff6a2a4-9988-4115-995c-4bf9ebac9fd7-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"e016d11681958111","images":[],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"【知财动摇无实质，如理施比丘梵志，亲朋贫者为他世，施外无余胜亲友。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2f516d116786f104","modified":1612428542256,"text":"随念布施"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"28516d1449915604d","images":[{"id":"10c16d144a5ce003a-1005400","oh":891,"ow":1907,"uri":"document_image/4ba5a3cf-82ad-4a5e-8cc2-a420f9f7a120-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"29e16d11685a870d8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【汝戒未失无缺憾，未混未染当依之，戒如动静之大地，一切功德之根本。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"27c16d1167af9b135","modified":1612428542256,"text":"随念持戒"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"23016d11670e7e17c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广述后三随念"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"20a16d11666dd9094","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说增上生与决定胜道之基础——信心"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"21016d1169696601c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【施戒安忍精进禅，如是无量智慧度，圆满趋向有海岸，成就如来正等觉。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"27516d1168a6990a9","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1516d116a986d069","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【何者孝敬父母亲，彼族具梵阿阇黎，供养彼等今名扬，他世亦转善趣中。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2f016d1169f04118f","modified":1612428542256,"note":"","text":"布施"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"","finish":false,"id":"3a316d116b4f3416f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【损害盗夺与淫行，妄语贪酒非时餐，喜高广床与歌唱，舞蹈花鬘皆当断。随行罗汉之戒律，若具此等八斋戒，持长净转欲天身，当赐善男善女人。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","finish":false,"id":"2f516d116ad8e3132","modified":1612428542256,"note":"","text":"所护之戒"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"","finish":false,"id":"38416d116b9f0d068","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【悭吝谄诳贪懈怠，贪欲嗔恨增上慢，及以种貌闻韶华，权势而骄视如敌。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"816d116adfa014d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除彼之违品"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"","finish":false,"id":"da16d12225bf9172","modified":1612428542256,"note":"","text":"【佛说不放逸甘露，放逸乃为死亡处，是故汝为增善法，当恒敬具不放逸。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"3e716d116b0da909b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"行持同品不放逸"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"","finish":false,"id":"32616d12260734126","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【何者昔日极放逸，尔后行为倍谨慎，如月离云极绚丽，难陀指鬘见乐同。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"1c416d116b272e119","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以比喻说明不放逸之利益"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"f516d116a0ad20fc","modified":1612428542256,"text":"持戒"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"f916d122701530c2","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是无等忍苦行，汝莫令嗔有机乘，断嗔获得不退果，此乃佛陀亲口说。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","finish":false,"id":"35116d12266b830ee","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫断除嗔恨之因"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"15516d12273cb60f9","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【我为此人相责骂，殴打击败夺吾财，耿耿于怀起冲突，断除怀恨即安眠。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"2db16d122693440e4","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除怀恨之果"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"28016d12276f4e0f8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当知心如于水面，土石之上绘图画，其中具惑如初者，诸求胜法如末者。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"14f16d1226ac44034","modified":1612428542256,"text":"旁述心之特点"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"37a16d122993b8179","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【佛说语言有三种，称心真实颠倒说，犹如蜂蜜鲜花粪，唯一当弃最末者。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"37f16d1226deea006","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除嗔恨之缘——粗语"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"12816d116a1f28129","modified":1612428542256,"text":"安忍"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"10d16d122a290e13c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【今明后明至究竟，今暗后暗至最终，今明后暗至终点，今暗后明至圆满。如是四种类型人，国王当做第一种。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"f516d1229e281196","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诲精进之对境"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"29516d122a75f506f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当知人类如芒果：外似成熟内未熟，内成熟外似未熟，内外未熟内外熟。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"2a316d122a0e1a15b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫表里如一之精进"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2ee16d116a44921","modified":1612428542256,"text":"精进"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1fd16d122cb9dd10d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【切莫眼瞧他妻室，若睹亦随其年龄，作母女儿姊妹想，若贪真观不净性。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"31d16d122c0970161","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫防护根门不贪他女人"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"31f16d122cedbc11e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当如闻子宝藏命，守护动摇之内心，犹如猛兽毒刀刃，怨敌烈火厌欲乐。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"3c716d122c5804153","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫护根门防止其他欲妙"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"31f16d122d2580178","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【一切欲妙生祸殃，佛说如同木鳖果，世间人以其铁镣，缚轮回狱当断彼。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"b816d122c769002","modified":1612428542256,"text":"未护根门之过患"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2a016d122d62dd037","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【知伏六根诸对境，恒时动摇不稳固，沙场胜敌此二者，初诸智者真勇士。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"16916d122c96290ac","modified":1612428542256,"text":"佛陀赞叹护根门"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"b116d122baf7b14d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以转变内想之方式禁护根门"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"11a16d122f376009f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当观少女身背后，臭气显露九孔门，如肮脏器难填满，皮饰遮掩亦不净。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"35716d122e1dcc055","modified":1612428542256,"text":"了知欲界主要贪欲之女身而断贪"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"8d16d122f6eee00c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如麻风病虫蠕动，为得乐受皆依火，非但不息苦更增，当知贪欲与彼同。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"32d16d122e3a830cf","modified":1612428542256,"text":"了知总贪欲之理而断贪"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"34116d122be91615","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以知对境之法相方式而断除贪执"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"19016d122b3a5907f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除对境之散乱"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"c416d12312efe08d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【为见胜义于诸法，如理作意而修习，与之相同具功德，他法少许亦无有。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"10f16d1230f7aa184","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实对治"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"7916d1231633a021","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【族貌闻虽具全士，然离慧戒非受敬，何者具此二功德，彼无他德亦应供。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"2de16d1231124a05","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说具对治之功德与不具对治之过患"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"5d16d1230ab4d04","modified":1612428542256,"text":"对治"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1d016d1231f615105","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【知世法者得与失，乐忧美言与恶语，赞毁世间此八法，非我意境当平息。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"24016d1231bde3021","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫断除真实世间八法"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"13416d12328c3e09d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【汝为沙门婆罗门，师客父母王妃眷，亦不应造诸罪业，地狱异熟他不分。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"8216d123252cf0b6","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实宣说"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1de16d1232c52213d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有者所造诸罪业，纵未即时如刀砍，然死降临头上时，罪业之果必现前。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"cc16d12325c7114","modified":1612428542256,"text":"需断彼之理"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"6b16d1231d91e18b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫断除彼之果——罪业"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"33416d1230d959116","modified":1612428542256,"text":"所断"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"1f316d122b55160fc","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除世间八法之散乱"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"6c16d12337a900b8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【佛说信心与持戒，多闻布施净知惭，有愧智慧圣七财，知余财物无实义。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"34b16d1232f9af04a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总说财物取舍之分类"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"2fa1718e4d05b9155","images":[{"id":"37f1718e564368168-1005400","oh":843,"ow":1858,"uri":"document_image/5f4e4587-d234-49e5-8e4c-e1c7f86b0da1-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"10316d1233aee004c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【赌博以及看聚会，懒惰依附恶劣友，饮酒夜晚入村落，断毁名誉之六法。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"29116d12333e320f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"别说断除无义琐事"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"14c1718e56676d137","images":[{"id":"3761718e56b44208a-1005400","oh":424,"ow":1343,"uri":"document_image/cd37ef0d-d751-4c1e-8c32-8e1c0e5422f9-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"28d16d12342aa50cd","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【佛说一切财产中，知足乃为最殊胜，是故应当常知足，知足无财真富翁。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"3c216d1233f9020e9","modified":1612428542256,"text":"对治之功德（对治贪执财富有什么功德）"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"6e1718e57c4dd08c","images":[{"id":"e21718e57fb4c0fd-1005400","oh":486,"ow":1633,"uri":"document_image/e718849b-1d2a-450c-aa9f-0854395aeb3f-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"9016d12345d16189","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【智者痛苦如财多，少欲之人非如是，一切龙王头数目，所生痛苦如是多。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"2bd16d123410f00c7","modified":1612428542256,"text":"未对治之过患（对贪执财产没有对治的过患）"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2f416d12335b0711a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"能断之对治"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"11c16d122b6f3c17c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除财物之散乱"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"23c1718e59771e07b","images":[{"id":"f21718e59cd9a075-1005400","oh":320,"ow":1633,"uri":"document_image/8e543504-c23d-4310-a5cd-92bd849f23ea-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"31f16d1236347f0b5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【性如联敌刽子手，轻凌夫君如恶女，微财不放如盗匪，当弃此等三妇人。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"16316d1235ff2317c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"应舍"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#333333","id":"1f71718e59daa116c","images":[{"id":"ba1718e5a08ad043-1005400","oh":347,"ow":1682,"uri":"document_image/5ca3e6c4-ac92-47bb-a140-043f29445f17-1005400.jpg"}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3a916d123665a115c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【随顺自己如姊妹，情投意合若挚友，仁爱自己似慈母，听从如仆敬若神。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"ae16d123618060b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"应取"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"5916d123564550e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除贪妻"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"25616d12369d4d09c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【了知饮食如良药，无有贪嗔而享用，非为骄横体健朗，唯一为使身生存。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"c316d1235833c10f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除贪食"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"20416d1236dfb1149","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【贤明君主勤度过，白昼上夜及下夜，睡时亦非徒无果，于中夜具正念眠。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"27216d12359c960f9","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除贪眠。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"2dd16d122b877f024","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除受用之散乱"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","id":"24716d122afd8f0f6","modified":1612428542256,"text":"断除违品散乱"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"39816d1237197c055","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【恒常真实而修持，慈悲喜舍四无量，纵然未证正等觉，亦得梵天无量乐。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","id":"16916d122b1795076","modified":1612428542256,"text":"修行同品四无量"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"30916d122a96e514e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"加行"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2c516d12396ad5055","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【以断欲行喜乐苦，四种禅定次第生，梵天光明遍净天，广果天之四天界。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2e116d122ac4e5062","modified":1612428542256,"text":"正行——教诫修四禅"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"24416d123abe51059","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【恒贪不具对治法，功德主田之事生，五种善恶更为重，故当精勤行大善。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"3216d1239f041074","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说善恶轻重"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"8e16d123b0ab3072","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【数两盐转少水味，非能改变恒河水，如是当知微小罪，无法摧毁大善根。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"14d16d123a87c509b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫具足对治不善之广大善法。"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"2fb16d1239acb2062","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总说弃恶从善"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3b316d123b42d518c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【掉举后悔与害心，昏睡贪欲及怀疑，当知此等五种障，乃夺善财之盗匪。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"2716d1239d3dd137","modified":1612428542256,"text":"尤其断除等持障之法"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2cc16d122adc47038","modified":1612428542256,"text":"后行"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"3a216d116a5b3d12c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"禅定"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1e016d123c8a420ed","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【信心精进与正念，等持智慧胜法位，当勤于此称力根，乃为顶位之本体。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"1f16d123c519904c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说应取之信等"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3a16d123cc09b18d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【病老死及爱别离，如此业即我所造，如是反复思维者，彼对治门不骄矜。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"2fd16d123c6ecf14b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以对治所断方式遣除骄矜。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"23c16d123bd4ca0e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说信等五根之道本体"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"13c16d123dcf06059","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【若求善趣与解脱，理当修习世正见，若持邪见纵行善，亦具难忍之苦果。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"ba16d123d8b310a2","modified":1612428542256,"text":"增上生与决定胜之根本——世间正见"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"30516d123e009a0e5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当知人本无安乐，无常无我不清净，未忆念此之众生，四颠倒见即祸根。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","id":"1816d123d960409e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"决定胜之根本——出世间正见"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"1b016d123d104a114","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说有寂一切善资根本即是智慧"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"24716d123f407118d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当悟经说色非我，我不具色非依存，色亦不依我而住，如是余四蕴皆空。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"a316d123ebc1705d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"抉择无我"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"28416d123f8c5a01a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当知蕴非随意生，非时节及自性生，非体自在非无因，乃由无明业爱生。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"14b16d123f1f09118","modified":1612428542256,"text":"观察我之所依蕴"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"5716d123e3b8e0d8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"别说重要之见"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1f116d124022a70f8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【理应了知戒禁取，萨迦耶见及怀疑，结缚有中此三者，阻塞解脱城市门。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"10316d123fce3f12","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说道之违品——三结"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"df16d12404f73177","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【解脱依赖于自己，他人不能作助伴，具足广闻戒定者，应当精勤修四谛。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"22b16d123fd77a054","modified":1612428542256,"text":"道之顺缘——精进"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"20d16d1240c48e0ca","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【理当恒常勤修学，殊胜戒律及慧定，二百五十余分戒，真实摄此三学中。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"7216d124086a3107","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总说三学"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"14f16d1241b6d50c3","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【自在忆念所属身，如来所示一捷径，彼当策励勤守护，丧失正念诸法亡。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"3cb16d12416b8d166","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"43xNfIAfW1","images":[{"id":"xG95ilozfF","oh":708,"ow":1894,"uri":"document_image/3813fdc3-c72d-4f92-a27a-395deb092171-1005400.jpg","w":395}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"25816d12429c90179","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【寿命多害即无常，犹如水泡为风吹，呼气吸气沉睡间，能得觉醒极稀奇！】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"20016d1242271a04b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维死期不定而修无常"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"HBgzcgrXWV","images":[{"id":"zeYhmEsupm","oh":417,"ow":1877,"uri":"document_image/35aa3913-44b8-4478-a6c4-868d807961a4-1005400.jpg","w":400}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2e916d1242cd1a0bc","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【身际如灰干际坠，终究不净无实质，当知一切皆坏灭，各自分散之自性。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"33d16d124242ed128","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维必死无疑而修无常"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"xw8ajZ9es5","images":[{"id":"HpvWnMjvIW","oh":244,"ow":1732,"uri":"document_image/449ea9fa-6c0a-4f8d-b4db-55606bafbf15-1005400.jpg","w":400}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"39a16d1242fdbc00d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【大地山王与海洋，终为七烈日所焚，有情无余化为尘，弱小人身岂堪言？】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2fd16d12425bc40c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维他理而修无常"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"1wg9Jen3Pi","images":[{"id":"d1fwrvy2EB","oh":350,"ow":1477,"uri":"document_image/6f9e764b-02e6-41b2-8d10-ac80b852a905-1005400.jpg","w":400}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"11c16d1243305412f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是无常与无我，无依无怙无存处，轮回无实如芭蕉，人君汝心当厌离。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"16916d12427c580e4","modified":1612428542256,"text":"此等之摄义"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"b416d1241ea67146","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维寿命无常"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"oodlFC6VfA","images":[{"id":"llDn2awPMS","oh":355,"ow":1725,"uri":"document_image/bc7e51c2-6160-4b2b-ba2e-f9cc7bb47d22-1005400.jpg","w":400}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"36c16d124442b802f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【大海漂浮木轭孔，与龟相遇极难得，旁生转人较此难，故王修法具实义。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3bb16d1243c350154","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说转生为人难得之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"","id":"bAeoUy2Wgb","images":[{"id":"jkjfkgPerl","oh":280,"ow":1725,"uri":"document_image/f09178de-824a-4e8f-bf9d-28e473b9d09d-1005400.jpg","w":400}],"modified":1612428542256,"text":"《上师讲记》"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"8f16d1244ac65084","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【谁以宝饰之金器，清除肮脏呕吐物，转生为人造罪业，与之相比更愚蠢。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"29516d124408fa08e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"谴责依此人身造罪。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2d016d124369540da","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总说转生普通人生难得之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"35516d12451fbd132","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【身处随圣之境地，依于殊胜之正士，己发宏愿积大福，此四大轮汝具足。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"b616d1244e163152","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总说四轮"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3b016d1245533000b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【依止真实善知识，梵行圆满能仁说，是故当依诸大德，依佛累世得寂灭。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"d716d124505b917e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"分说善知识"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"18b16d1243864f13e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"别说具四轮之人身"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"14216d124581f7062","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【执持邪见转旁生，投生饿鬼堕地狱，无有佛教于边地，转成痴哑野蛮人，长寿天生任一处，此等即是八无暇，远离此等得闲暇，为不转生当精进。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"2c16d124389be07a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维远离违缘八无暇之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"10716d1242082509a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维暇满难得"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"39316d12419d38084","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"16116d12413e960e7","modified":1612428542256,"text":"厌离此生之方法"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"27716d124696980c3","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【智者于此求不得，病老死等众多苦，根源轮回当生厌，亦应倾听彼过患。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"29316d12460976148","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"35b16d1247e6a2027","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【父转成子母成妻，怨敌复次成亲友，是故流转轮回者，无有少许确定性。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"5d16d1247557c105","modified":1612428542256,"text":"亲怨不定故不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"30216d1248308d184","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【每一众生所饮乳，胜过四大海洋水，今仍流转投异生，未来所饮更过彼。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"29616d1247796a0c8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"无有满足故不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"a616d12486c490ac","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【过去每世所遗骨，堆积一处超山王，地土抟成枣核丸，其量不及为母数。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"27b16d12479dcc133","modified":1612428542256,"text":"后际不定故不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"33316d12496da2076","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【帝释堪称世间供，以业感召亦堕地，纵然曾为转轮王，于轮回中复成仆。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"e116d1248aa7d07a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"国政不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1c316d1249a05b13b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【纵然长期于天界，享用婀娜之天女，复堕地狱遭碎断，感受极难忍受苦。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"22716d1248d4b0072","modified":1612428542256,"text":"悦意友伴不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"f416d1249d595165","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【长久居于山王巅，随足起伏极惬意，复沦煻煨尸粪泥，同熏难忍之苦味。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2f16d1248ee2b18d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"美妙住处不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"4216d124a1c06095","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【与诸天女相倚喜，美丽乐园共嬉戏，复将为诸剑叶林，斩断手足与耳鼻。或入曼陀妙池沼，天女金花艳彩容，舍身步入无滩河，炽门难挡受热浪。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3ac16d124914a003c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"安乐行境不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1f316d124a5a5115e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【欲天界中大乐者，梵天离贪得安乐，复成无间狱火薪，不断感受痛苦也。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"16716d12492f63136","modified":1612428542256,"text":"丰厚受用不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"36916d124a8b2a024","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【获生日月自身光，照耀一切世间界，死后复至黑暗处，伸展自手亦不见。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3d016d124947b9023","modified":1612428542256,"text":"庄严威光不可信赖之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"22b16d1247a3bc0c8","modified":1612428542256,"text":"高低不定故不可信赖之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"21f16d1247119d0f6","modified":1612428542256,"text":"不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"6516d124ac3d70e9","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是知成罪恶后，当撑三福之明灯，独自趋入日月光，无法遣除之暗处。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3c716d124734e50dc","modified":1612428542256,"text":"知此而教诫修善"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"32f16d1246d5b8068","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说现似快乐不可信赖之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"7616d138a2191112","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【屡屡造罪之众生，复合黑绳极烧热，众合号叫无间等，诸地狱中恒受苦。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"9016d1389d82b05f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2416d138b55b90de","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有被压榨如芝麻，另有碎成如细粉，有者以锯锯割之，有以难忍利斧劈。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1d116d138bad9b096","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有于沸腾溶液中，灌注炽烧之铜汁，有被炽燃铁戈刺，周身缠绕利荆棘，】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2f516d138bf63e077","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有被铁齿之猛犬，撕扯双手仰向天，利喙飞禽尖爪鸦，持执身已不由己。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1e516d138c26f9169","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有以各种昆虫类，万数黑蝇蜂触食，遍体鳞伤实难忍，辗转反侧出哀号。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2aa16d138c6bea09c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有者置于火烬堆，不断被焚口亦张，有于铁制巨锅中，身成小团被烹调。】"}],"id":"3c016d138b149b03d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实痛苦"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"31616d138d160b147","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【造罪之人乃至于，气息未灭存活时，闻诸地狱无量苦，毫不生畏如金刚。】"}],"id":"3be16d138cbe370d5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维生时"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"b716d138db7e10fe","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【即便见闻地狱图，忆念读诵或造形，亦能生起怖畏心，何况真受异熟果。】"}],"id":"1dc16d138d674614b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总思维"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3be16d138df5d908b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【所有一切安乐中，灭尽三有堪乐王，如是一切痛苦中，无间狱苦最难忍。】"}],"id":"39a16d138d8109048","modified":1612428542256,"text":"别思维"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"d516d138e9f7a038","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【于此一日中感受，三百短矛猛刺苦，彼较地狱最微苦，难忍之分亦不及。】"}],"id":"32116d138d98b80eb","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维比喻"}],"id":"23216d138cdce914b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维生而难忍之情景"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"17f16d138edf9b025","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是剧苦极难耐，百俱胝年亲感受，乃至恶业未穷尽，期间必定不离命。】"}],"collapsed":false,"finish":false,"id":"11616d138cf643039","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维感受长短"}],"id":"7e16d138b32d405f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"思维何故产生之理"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"35b16d138a7c7317a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"当知痛苦"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"6f16d138f24bc06f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【诸不善果之种子，即身语意造恶业，尽力不染纤尘许，汝当如是而精勤。】"}],"collapsed":false,"id":"3316d138ab6c2102","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫断除彼因"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"38516d1389f2d6134","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"13016d138918450be","modified":1612428542256,"text":"地狱之苦"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"36c16d138ff2ba169","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【旁生生处亦遭杀，捆绑殴打各种苦，弃离趋寂诸善法，相互啖食极难忍。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"f216d138fa19a10a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"总痛苦"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"31f16d13904f51034","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有因珍珠有因毛，血肉骨皮而遭杀，毫无自由受人打，鞭抽铁勾等役使。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ed16d138fd86c0c5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"散居旁生别苦"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2e016d138943f0146","modified":1612428542256,"text":"旁生之苦"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1b316d1390d06e07a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【饿鬼所欲不遂意，屡生痛苦不可转，饥渴寒热疲畏惧，所生极其难忍苦。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2a916d13909c13158","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"13b16d1391ba08069","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有者口小如针眼，腹如山丘饥所缠，虽得少许不净物，然无享用之能力。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"5816d13929a67147","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有者裸体皮包骨，瘦骨嶙峋如干薪，有者夜晚口燃火，投火飞蛾吞入口。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"28f16d1392d295104","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【有者劣种排脓血，粪等脏物亦不得，相互殴打从喉中，出生肿瘤化脓食。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"38f16d1393010b013","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【诸饿鬼界春季时，月亮亦炽冬日寒，树木不生诸果实，仅望一眼河亦干。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"14116d13915e5a103","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实痛苦"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"17316d139328630c5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【连续不断受痛苦，有为所造罪业索，紧紧束缚之众生，寿命五千或万年。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"1e716d139181d0006","modified":1612428542256,"text":"感受时间"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"6216d1391002b163","modified":1612428542256,"text":"痛苦"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"24716d139381350bc","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是一切诸饿鬼，一味获得种种苦，彼因爱财如命士，非圣吝啬佛所说。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"17e16d13912f0e08c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"苦因"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"20f16d1390b8b615b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"29c16d13895cda14c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"饿鬼之苦"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"25a16d1394a1a402d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【天界虽具大安乐，死堕痛苦大于彼，如是思维高尚士，不贪终尽之天趣。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"19316d1393e7030a7","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1b516d1397b146061","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【身色变得极丑陋，花鬘枯萎不喜座，衣染污垢身体上，前所未有汗汁流。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"10916d139828ae121","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【天境天人已出现，天界死堕之五相，犹如地上临终者，所示一切之死兆。】"},{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2ab16d1398a61f0a1","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【由天界中死堕者，设若善根毫无余，后不自主而投生，旁生饿鬼地狱处。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"36516d139455e9145","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3b516d13897a460be","modified":1612428542256,"text":"天人之苦"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3316d1398f7b0153","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【非天嗔恨天福故，心中生起大痛苦，虽具智慧以趣障，无法现见真实谛。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"26a16d1389973d142","modified":1612428542256,"text":"非天之苦"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ef16d124afbc20eb","modified":1612428542256,"text":"当知轮回乃痛苦之自性"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"25516d1399a4440cd","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【轮回自性即如此，天人地狱饿鬼畜，生于何趣皆不妙，当知乃为多害器。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"1e816d139949090f5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"需避免转生之理由"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"816d1399e589045","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【头或衣上骤燃火，放弃一切扑灭之，精勤趋入涅槃果，无余比此更重要。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"1e316d1399652d121","modified":1612428542256,"text":"因此为避免转生当猛厉精勤"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"29216d124b199f116","modified":1612428542256,"text":"知后为避免转生需精勤"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"39a16d1246ded605f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说痛苦巨大之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"38716d124654750cc","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"2b116d124147220eb","modified":1612428542256,"text":"厌离一切轮回之方法——思维轮回过患"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"23f16d1240f9e70b3","modified":1612428542256,"text":"说明出离染污品之理"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"13d16d139b3a9a00c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【以戒定慧趣涅槃，寂静调柔无垢染，无有穷尽无老死，得离四大日月果。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"22a16d139aed9f0b7","modified":1612428542256,"text":"当诚信解脱果"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"19616d139c0d73147","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【正念择法及精进，心喜轻安及等持，等舍此七谓觉支，证得涅槃之善资。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"34f16d139bcad20f3","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说道之本体七觉支"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"","finish":false,"id":"30016d139c8dfb148","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【当知无慧无禅定，无有禅定亦无慧，何者定慧兼有之，轮回海成蹄迹水。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"9216d139c5b89182","modified":1612428542256,"text":"略说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"13416d139d1fc418c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【所谓十四无记法，世间日亲所言说，于此等法莫思索，依之非令心寂灭。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"e916d139cc20500f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说所净颠倒趋入实相之未授记见"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2616d139e321f07f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【无明生行行生识，由彼中生名与色，由名色中生六处，从中生触能仁说。触中生受彼生爱，由爱生取彼生有，从有出生若有生，出忧病老求不得，死与畏等剧苦蕴，生灭则令一切灭。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"25e16d139dd9b300b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实缘起"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"24116d139ec59c108","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【此缘起乃佛语藏，弥足珍贵最甚深，何者若能真见此，已睹真如佛法身。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"30e16d139e037205c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"赞评彼之优点"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"5116d139cdd0a166","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说对治清净实相缘起之义"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3b816d139c748f016","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"32716d139bebfb119","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说别相与寂止相联甚深智慧瑜伽"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"6a16d139b71720ef","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说见道"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"35816d13a3a3e016b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【正见正命与正勤，正念正定与正语，正业正思八圣道，为获寂灭当修此。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"34e16d13a2a7ab118","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说道之本体八正道"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"20c16d13a3eaad0b2","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【此生即苦称谓爱，爱即彼之集谛因，灭尽此等即解脱，能得即八圣道支。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ee16d13a2c1e403","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说彼为道之理"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2cf16d13a441bf198","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【事实如此故为见，圣者四谛恒精勤。】"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"3d16d13a2e9ce054","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教授彼道主要为见四谛之智慧"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"1c716d139b9432134","modified":1612428542256,"text":"宣说修道"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2016d139b0ccb02d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"实修因之道谛"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"","id":"2e616d124104200bd","modified":1612428542256,"text":"说明善入清净品之理"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"2ff16d12408f0007d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"别说慧学"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"25d16d1240068004c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"修学道之本体——三学"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","finish":false,"id":"3ad16d123e84ac0c3","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实之道"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"","id":"ee16d123d3b590f7","modified":1612428542256,"text":"真实宣说具智慧之道。"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","id":"1a916d123bf47c13b","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说正念等智慧"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"2e616d116a74c80e2","modified":1612428542256,"text":"智慧"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"1c916d1169e79600a","modified":1612428542256,"text":"广说"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"16216d13b2461f047","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【未抛舍财诸俗人，了知取舍越惑河，现前圣法之彼等，亦非从天而降临，非如庄稼由地出，昔随惑转之异生。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"15516d13b11047126","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以劣身亦能成就之理赐安慰"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"4a16d13b28608089","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【离畏何需更繁述，有益窍诀此义藏，汝当调心世尊说，心乃诸法之根本。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"12c16d13b13d9c13e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以简要实修之理赐安慰"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2da16d13b2ebbd","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是奉劝汝教言，纵是比丘难尽行，随力能修其一德，当令人生具实义。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"3a216d13b167b7003","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以力所能及实修之理赐安慰"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"3e516d1168ad94026","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教诫实行彼等之义"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"2ab16d1166aedd09e","modified":1612428542256,"text":"道之本体"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","heading":1,"id":"25f16d115fb7c0169","modified":1612428542256,"text":"中善论义"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"31016d13b5783a131","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【随喜诸善三门善，为得佛果普回向。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"23716d13b542f6067","modified":1612428542256,"text":"回向"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2bb16d13b68c3f163","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【如是以此善福蕴，汝于无量生世中，拥有天人世间福，犹如圣者观自在，摄受数多苦难众，出世除老病贪嗔。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#333333","id":"16816d13b6513101d","modified":1612428542256,"text":"暂时道果"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"25316d13b7a446098","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【犹如阿弥陀佛尊，世间怙主寿无量。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#333333","id":"38416d13b6717d0b5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"究竟佛果"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"28816d13b55e9110c","modified":1612428542256,"text":"彼之果"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"20616d13b44f4d06f","modified":1612428542256,"text":"教授随喜与回向"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"37816d13b88ebd139","modified":1612428542256,"text":"【戒慧施生净大名，遍及虚空大地上，人类天众妙龄者，喜乐生爱定寂灭。尽息惑缠苦有情，坏生死证如来性，超离尘世名亦息，证得无惧无罪果。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"34016d13b49648104","modified":1612428542256,"text":"以摄上述道果诸义而教诲"}],"color":"#3da8f5","heading":1,"id":"2f216d115fdf79088","modified":1612428542256,"text":"末善尾义"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","heading":1,"id":"1b616d115f5f080c5","modified":1612428542256,"text":"论义"}],"structure":"right","theme":"fresh"}
